hazard that poses serious threats to human life, property,
and infrastructure. Inﬂuenced by the intensiﬁcation of global cli-

and severity of lands

ing [1]. According to statistics released by the National Bureau
of Statistics of China, a total of 2335 landslide events occurred
in 2024, resulting in 129 casualties, including 8 fatalities, and
causing direct economic losses of up to CNY 3.20 billion [2].

to capture both ﬁne-grained details and b

boundary delineation precision and semantic coherence. The
SFM further bridges the gap be

CS-Mamba consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in
